name: Renfield: The Docket Never Sleeps
description: Lurk, silent (~40 s): he keeps the docket of the road alone, jotting, striking out, dotting, a signature flourish and two shivers of delight.

name: Renfield: Notarizing the Moths
description: Lurk, silent (~38 s): slow careful strokes, a frenzy of writing with a long tremble, three stamps in triplicate, counted taps, one more shudder.

name: Renfield: Name for the Record
description: Wake greeting (~10 s): a shiver and a scribble, then he begs the guest's name for the record and holds the pen up, waiting.

steps.text: [excited] A client! A CLIENT! Your name, if you please, for the record. Speak up, speak up... the pen is waiting.

name: Renfield: The Vetting
description: Story (~85 s): he vets a passer-by in three questions (name, trade, consideration), draws an indenture with the Count in triplicate, the Count answers from the hall, and the new client is sent up the hill.

steps.text: [excited] Whereas a traveller approaches the road! Question the first: your name. Let me write that down. Scribble, scribble... there.
Question the second: your trade. Heretofore I have signed two bakers, a dentist and a moth. [chuckles] The moth drove a hard bargain.
Question the third, the consideration. What would you GIVE the Master? A Tuesday? A tooth? Your shadow, in fee simple?
So stipulated! An indenture with Count Orlok, in triplicate, witnessed by a moth. Sign here... and here... and HERE.
[Romanian accent] [breathes] Another name for your Lord, Renfield? Da. Send the client up the hill... slooowly.
[whispers] He's pleased. He's PLEASED. Up the hill with you, client. Tell the Count Renfield drew it, and watch his face.

name: Renfield: Pumpkins by Contract
description: Story (~80 s): he sells a baby pumpkin from the patch by quitclaim and under seal, Pumpkinhead protests from the patch, the objection is overruled, the pumpkin burns in the roof window and the buyer is sent to collect.

steps.text: [chuckles] Pumpkins! Fine baby pumpkins, conveyed by quitclaim, fresh from the patch. Whereas the patch is... technically... not mine. Details.
One pumpkin, under seal, to the party of the first part. That is you. Let me write that down... SOLD!
Pumpkinhead heard that. Snap. The clerk sold ANOTHER baby. Pumpkinhead did not sign... and the stalks are counting, Renfield.
[whispers] Opposing counsel objects. Overruled! Null and void. Clause nine: pumpkins cannot sign. The pen, the PEN, quickly...
Look, the roof window! Your pumpkin, ripening nicely. Collect it from Pumpkinhead himself, and show him the seal.
[sighs] He does not love the seal.

name: Renfield: The Oldest Deed
description: Story (~75 s): he opens the oldest deed in the registry, finds a name from 1462 he will not say, trembles, and the knight warns the guest off; the guest carries word to the knight.

steps.text: [whispers] The registry, the oldest drawer. A deed, heretofore unread, older than the castle stones. One moment, the pen.
Fourteen sixty-two. Signed in a hand I know... a name I will NOT read aloud. Strike that from the record!
Per my last correspondence with eternity, some names are sworn before me and kept. Kept, kept. The ink still moves, you see.
[Romanian accent] Sign nothing, traveller. Tell the clerk the knight said so.
[chuckles] Opposing counsel. Noted, noted. Tell the knight the east file is secure. And you saw nothing. Affidavit to follow.

name: Renfield: Collect from Pumpkinhead
description: Send-off (~35 s): he writes the guest a receipt in triplicate, points the pen down the road to the patch, Pumpkinhead counts his babies coldly, and the guest is sent on to collect.

steps.text: [excited] Your receipt! Duly recorded, in triplicate, by order of the Master. Take it down the road and present it to Pumpkinhead himself.
Should he snap, recite clause four: notwithstanding all objections, the pumpkin is yours. Should he still snap... run. Off you go!
Another paper from the clerk? Pumpkinhead counts... eleven babies left. Which one did the clerk sell YOU?

name: Renfield: The Covenant
description: Fleet event 1 (ceremony, ~30 s): the pen scribbles before the first word and under every line; he reads the covenant of the night, shakes at the Count's name, begs the sidewalk to sign; three more strokes; Home.

steps.text: Whereas! The night is hereby convened. Witnesseth: the party of the first part, Count Orlok, holds this ground in perpetuity.
Let it be written. Let it be... [frantic] written! Sign here, sidewalk. Sign here!

name: Renfield: Everything Is Recorded
description: Fleet event 2 (orders, ~32 s): the pen never stops, 300 ms strokes under every word; he records the knight's refusal, drafts the patch contract and shakes on 'signed'; Home.

steps.text: Recorded! "The knight refused." Underlined twice. Heretofore and notwithstanding, the party of the second part is... a pumpkin.
[frantic] A contract for the patch, witnesseth, in perpetuity... signed, sealed... delivered! Master, it is DONE. Who else wants one?

name: Renfield: The Solicitor's Verse
description: Fleet event 3 (song, ~18 s): the pen taps time, a 250 ms stroke about every 650 ms, through his verse; the shake lands on 'Count'; Home.

steps.text: [sings] Whereas, heretofore, and party of the first, I'll write your name, I'll write it worst! A contract for the Count tonight. Sign here! All right!
